one_line: Open on an unexplained 'this will happen again' over a real moment, then show five kids using the product.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a young baby lies tummy-down on a cream foam arch, a hand supporting her; from 0:02 an arm wipes the arch with a cloth. Voiceover and subtitle: 'זה הולך לקרות עוד כל כך הרבה פעמים, אבל איזה מזל שידעתי'.
q1_hook.why: A line that starts mid-story over a baby on the product and a wiping arm opens a gap: what happened (H5, H1). The product is on screen and handled at 0:00 (S1), and voice and subtitle start together (H6). The gap closes at 0:16, 'most important, it wipes clean'.

beats.what: Baby on the arch, an arm wipes it; 'זה הולך לקרות עוד כל כך הרבה'
beats.why: A mid-story line with a hint of mess.

beats.what: She laughs beside a RAINBOW SET box, pulls off the wrap; 'תכירו את כלי הנשק החדש', 'חמישה ילדים'
beats.why: Funny framing: the product as a weapon.

beats.what: Close-ups of the leather-like surface and the inner arch; 'יפה ומתאימה לקו העיצובי'
beats.why: Shows the material and the look.

beats.what: Mother and baby on the arch; 'והכי חשוב מתנקה'
beats.why: Answers the opening wipe: easy to clean.

beats.what: Older kids tilt and rock the arch; 'אין מצב'
beats.why: From baby use to older kids.

beats.what: The arch as a tunnel, a child crawls; a stacked arch tower; 'זה מפתח להם את היצירתיות'
A girl dances on the rocking arch, kids climb on; 'טוב, עזבו אותי, תראו בעצמכם'
No speech or text: five kids rock, climb, lift a piece, a girl lies back in the rocker
beats.why: Pure play is the energy peak.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None in the video. The caption is a first-person story with three numbered buying conditions, and asks nothing.
q2_flow.why: The opening gap is paid off at 0:16 (H5). A new picture every 1 to 3 s, moving from baby to older kids to all five, adds something each time (R3, K2). The last 10 s of pure play are the peak (R4, K1). The unboxing at 0:05 to 0:12 is the slowest stretch (R1).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. The voiceover ends 'עזבו אותי, תראו בעצמכם' (0:29, subtitle at 0:30), which leads into the play footage. Caption: no ask, link, code or price; it ends 'בשיתוף @bliss.il'.
q3_cta.why: 'Look for yourselves' invites watching, not acting. A parent who wants the arch has no link, price or where to buy (C6). The numbered conditions in the caption are useful but ask nothing (R6).

q4_shown.what: A baby on the arch and a wiping arm 0:00 to 0:04; a RAINBOW SET box, unwrapping 0:05 to 0:12; close-ups of the surface 0:13; older kids rocking, tunnelling, stacking, dancing 0:19 to 0:29; five children 0:31 to 0:40. No price.
q4_shown.why: The arch is handled from 0:00, and the wipe shown first backs the cleaning claim (S1, K4). Children of several ages in different uses are the real proof of 'keeps them all busy' (K5, R3). The close-ups answer how it looks (F4). Children's faces are shown (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 20 shots in 41 s (about 2 s each): one static unboxing take (0:06 to 0:12), then handheld cuts every 1 to 3 s. Subtitles in 1 to 2 line chunks, current word highlighted, until 0:30; the last 10 s have no text.
q5_edit.why: A slow unboxing then fast handheld cuts mirrors calm then chaos (E2, R3). Highlighted-word subtitles in short chunks keep the eye moving (E4). It stops mid-play with no closing line or ask (E8).

q6_topic.what: A foam arch as a coping tool for a mother of five in the summer break: keeps all ages busy, wipes clean, fits the home. Serves large-family parents.
q6_topic.why: Calling the product a 'weapon' against five kids and the long holiday is a real, funny parent struggle (K3, K6), tied to a buying moment, the summer break (K7). Kids' delight is the peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Phone: a static wide frame for the unboxing beside a coffee table and curtains, then handheld at the children's height with pans and motion blur, and close-ups of the arch surface. Indoor light. A mother, a baby and four older children.
q7_filmed.why: Static for the unboxing and handheld for the play suit the content (F8). Close-ups fill the frame (F4). Real chaos reads as homemade (H8), though the blur and speed make faces hard to hold (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: White light-serif subtitles, 1 to 2 lines, the current word highlighted, at about 78 to 82% of the frame height, until 0:30: 'זה הולך לקרות עוד כל כך הרבה' (0:01), 'תכירו את כלי הנשק החדש' (0:05), 'יפה ומתאימה לקו העיצובי' (0:14), 'והכי חשוב מתנקה' (0:16), 'תראו בעצמכם.' (0:30). No headline card. The last 10 s have no text.
q8_text.caption: 'כשיש חמישה ילדים וכלב בבית כל יום הוא מופע ג'אגלינג אחד גדול 🤹‍♀️'. A first-person story, three numbered buying conditions, then 'בשיתוף @bliss.il'. About 120 words, no hashtags, question or CTA.
q8_text.why: Subtitles with highlighted key words let a muted viewer follow (T1, T2), but sit in the bottom band over the children (T4, F2). The caption's first line is a relatable moment, and the numbered conditions are save-worthy (R7), but it has no hashtags (T7). The partnership word comes last (T8, S7).

weak_points: Subtitles in the bottom band over the children; no CTA, price or size; five children's faces; the last 10 s without text or a closing line; the partnership word only at the end of the caption.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on a mid-story line over the product, answer it a few seconds later, and number the parent's reasons to buy in the caption. Hands and book.
not_verified: The machine transcript misreads a few words, so quotes follow the subtitles. What 'it' refers to in the first line (the wipe suggests a spill). Whether the baby is hers; paid status (label 0, four family accounts listed as co-authors). Music (none evident). Correction: voice and subtitles end at about 0:30.
